verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Qodo exposing its own Agentic Toolbox skills AS an MCP server for other agents (Claude Code, Codex, Kiro) to consume (qodo-docs-6, qodo-docs-33, qodo-probe-3), not Qodo itself acting as an MCP client that ingests external MCP servers' tools. No documentation shows a way to configure/plug third-party MCP servers into Qodo's own agent/CLI so it can use their tools.
